mechanism: Betamethasone reduces the antihypertensive efficacy of lisinopril through sodium retention, fluid accumulation, and increased vascular reactivity; conversely, lisinopril may increase potassium levels while betamethasone decreases them, creating opposing effects on electrolytes.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely and serum potassium levels regularly; may require lisinopril dose adjustment or additional antihypertensive therapy; counsel patient on sodium restriction.
